"The sugar industry is the second largest agro-based industry in India after cotton textiles. Sugarcane is a weight-losing and perishable crop; its sucrose content begins to deteriorate rapidly through inversion within 24 to 48 hours after harvesting. Furthermore, sugar recovery from cane typically ranges between only 9 to 12 percent. Consequently, sugar mills must be located in close proximity to sugarcane producing fields.
